d.item: THE SIGMA IDENTIFICATION — L154: B1012's gravitational σ vs. B254's (E₆)₁ central charge c=6 (CROSSING_REQUIREMENTS R11-T2)
d.headline: TWO-OBJECTS-EQUAL-AT-A-CANDIDATE-VALUE, NO IDENTIFICATION — this maps onto the record's own banked verdicts UNDECIDED (B1034) / UNDECIDED-narrowed (B1064), not onto ONE-OBJECT and not onto NOT-COMPARABLE. Both "6"s are exact rationals in the identical Virasoro-central-charge convention (no hidden normalization factor), and coincide only at σ := 1 — a value DEFINED by assuming the match, not independent evidence for it. No forcing bridge is banked (B1034: NO-EXHIBIT); nothing clashes either (NO-CLASH). The single most direct attempt to construct the bridge is structurally NOT-POSABLE (B1064, outcome O3): the object's own amphichirality deletes the quantized sector where (E6)_1-type rational data would have to live, and the surviving unquantized σ-sector carries no banked chiral algebra and no real form to host one. A2 = c = 6σ remains a live sealed anchor, status HELD-PENDING-L154, unresolved through the most recent bank found (B1076, 2026-08-19).

claims.statement: B1012's σ is the real part of the level t = k + iσ in the complex-Chern–Simons ('Gukov split') description of the object's own discrete-faithful geometric connection (S = (t/2)ĉ + c.c. with ĉ = i(Vol+iCS)), equivalently the gravitational CS level σ = ℓ/(4G) in the AdS₃-gravity-as-complex-CS dictionary (ℓ = AdS radius, G = Newton's constant). Its role in c=6σ: this IS Brown–Henneaux's c = 3ℓ/2G rewritten via σ — a definitional identity given three named classical inputs, not a coincidence.
claims.evidence: Re-ran frontier/B1012_branch_verifications/b1012_verify.py verbatim on this bench (python3 b1012_verify.py): all four checks True — 'S_equals_minus_CSk_minus_Vol_sigma', 'c_equals_6sigma', 'G_equals_1_over_4sigma_at_l1', 'I_equals_cVol_over_6pi', 'I_equals_sigmaVol_over_pi' (exact sympy symbolic algebra, no floats). Source: frontier/B1012_branch_verifications/FINDINGS.md §1-2.

claims.statement: The object's own action is identically blind to k and sighted in σ: ∂S/∂k = -CS ≡ 0 once CS=0 (amphichirality), while ∂S/∂σ = -Vol ≠ 0. CS=0 for the cusped amphichiral object is a separately banked, independently titled result (B303), cited by B1012 not assumed inside it.

B303's claim read directly: frontier/B303_clock_is_the_cp_sign/FINDINGS.md line 10, 'The cusped (amphichiral) object has CS = 0 — the CP-symmetric origin of the clock (no sign).'

claims.statement: B254's 6 is c((E6)_1) = 78/13 = 6 exactly, the Sugawara/Virasoro central charge of the level-1 E6 WZW current algebra (c=k·dim(g)/(k+h^∨); dim E6=78, dual Coxeter h^∨(E6)=12) — E6 chosen because it is the McKay-forced label of the figure-eight knot's own trace field ℚ(√−3) via the binary tetrahedral group 2T (B125/B210/B249, cited not re-derived here). This 6 equals exactly the sum c(SU(3)_2)=16/5 (dim 8, h^∨ 3, level 2) + c((G2)_1)=14/5 (dim 14, h^∨ 4, level 1) = 6, via the known conformal embedding (E6)_1 ⊃ SU(3)_2 × (G2)_1 (a c=0 coset) — NOT a level-rank duality, which is a different, unrelated WZW phenomenon (SU(N)_k↔SU(k)_N); none of the three quantities compared here is itself 'a level' mislabeled as a central charge.
claims.evidence: Independently recomputed from scratch with sympy Rational arithmetic (78/13=6; 16/5; 14/5; sum=6) AND reproduced frontier/B254_uniqueness_chain/uniqueness_chain.py verbatim (python3 uniqueness_chain.py → 'ALL CHECKS PASS'; prints c((G2)_1)=14/5, c((E6)_1)=6, '16/5+14/5=6=c((E6)_1)'). Source: frontier/B254_uniqueness_chain/FINDINGS.md spine table.

claims.statement: No rescaling/conversion factor sits between the two c's. Brown–Henneaux's c=3ℓ/2G is BY CONSTRUCTION the Virasoro central charge of the asymptotic-symmetry algebra (the coefficient of the standard [L_m,L_n] central term); the Sugawara c=k·dim(g)/(k+h^∨) is BY CONSTRUCTION the Virasoro central charge inherited by the stress tensor of a level-k current algebra — the same normalized quantity in both conventions. If a boundary identification existed, the comparison would be a direct unscaled equality.
claims.evidence: Conventions chased explicitly (both formulas' standard derivations fix the same central-term normalization); cross-checked against frontier/B1034_l154_sigma/FINDINGS.md V3(c), the 'unit fence (D-iii)': 'the c-match fixes ℓ/G = 4σ — a ratio; A1 is untouched on every branch.' The four-referent 'c' terminology row (B1064 §1 item 2) independently confirms the corpus itself distinguishes Sugawara c((E6)_1)=6 / c_BH=6σ / the cusp-torus theory's own c / B559's unrelated c=1 chain as four distinct referents requiring the subject to be stated.

claims.statement: σ = 1 is NOT independently derived — it is the unique solution of 6σ=6 obtained by ASSUMING c_BH = c_stage. Solving that equation restates the hypothesis being tested; it is not evidence for it ('the circularity guard').
claims.evidence: frontier/B1034_l154_sigma/PREREGISTRATION.md: 'The circularity guard: the c-match itself (6σ = 6 ⟺ σ = 1) is the SAME branch's content, not evidence for it. Evidence = the map or the clash, nothing else.'

claims.statement: The direct sealed test of the identification (L154, arc B1034) searched the corpus for a forcing map along three fixed candidate routes and found NO-EXHIBIT on all three (every co-occurrence of the two sides in the record is the question's own registration, not a derivation), and separately checked for a clash (chirality, quantization, units) and found NO-CLASH — landing at the sealed verdict UNDECIDED, explicitly distinct from DIFFERENT.
claims.evidence: frontier/B1034_l154_sigma/FINDINGS.md V2 ('The record contains no map... the corpus, to its credit, never pretended one'), V3 ('NO-CLASH, by reasoning recorded, not by absence-assertion'); PREREGISTRATION.md's sealed verdict table (NO-EXHIBIT × NO-CLASH → UNDECIDED).

claims.statement: The single most direct attempted CONSTRUCTION of the missing bridge — attaching the (E6)_1 fingerprint (c=6, {16/5,14/5}) to the boundary-torus theory of the object's own complex Chern-Simons theory (B1064) — returns O3, NOT-POSABLE, on two legs: (i) the quantized sector, where (E6)_1's integer-level rational modular data would have to live, is deleted identically by the object's own action (∂S/∂k=-CS≡0 at CS=0, claim 2); (ii) the surviving unquantized σ-sector carries no banked chiral algebra at all (B1034's own no-hit search) and, independently, the geometric holonomy admits no real form of E6(ℂ) (B715: non-real adjoint trace, exact in ℚ(√−3)), so a non-compact/continuous boundary theory is the natural expectation there — structurally unlike (E6)_1's finite rational data. B1064's pre-sealed definition (§2) fires its own UNDEFINED clause: the comparison (does P(T_cusp)=(6,{16/5,14/5})?) has no left-hand side to evaluate.
claims.evidence: frontier/B1064_cusp_torus_repose/FINDINGS.md (Legs 1-2, V1-V3) and frontier/B1064_cusp_torus_repose/PREREGISTRATION.md §2, §4. Leg 1's action-identity independently re-verified via sympy (claim 2). Leg 2's B715 non-real-trace figure (frontier/B715_native_gauge/FINDINGS.md Probe 2: 'tr Ad_{e6}(ρ(a)) = 37437270 + 38799960√3·i') and B1034's no-hit are read directly, not independently re-derived from E6 representation matrices in this session — cited, not recomputed here.

claims.statement: Even a fully positive attachment (O1: exhibit + fingerprint match on the cusp torus) would not, by itself, convert σ to DERIVED. B1064 names a further, separately required 'transfer statement' connecting the cusp-torus boundary theory's central charge to the actual Brown-Henneaux/AdS3 c=6σ; equating them without it is the explicitly fenced move (positing k_anyon = k_gravity, B980), held open and not adopted. Only outcome O2 (attachment PLUS the transfer statement) converts the anchor; O1 alone is only 'progress.'
claims.evidence: frontier/B1064_cusp_torus_repose/PREREGISTRATION.md §0 ('An exhibit on the cusp torus does NOT license cusp-c ⇔ c_BH... equating them POSITS k_anyon = k_gravity') and §4 (O1 vs O2 outcome definitions).

claims.statement: A2 (= c = 6σ, i.e. σ itself) is currently a live, sealed ANCHOR (free continuous input) in the framework's declared anchor set, not an output. Its two successive stronger justifications were both explicitly withdrawn in the record ('licensed by theorem' withdrawn per the L153 frame-bit finding; 'the object cannot set σ' withdrawn per B1012's own ∂S/∂σ≠0 result). Current epistemic status: HELD-PENDING-L154 — it stays an anchor unless/until L154 resolves SAME, at which point it converts to OUTPUT and the framework's only continuous dimensionless input shrinks off the list.
claims.evidence: frontier/B1015_anchor_declaration/FINDINGS.md ('A2 = c = 6σ (the unquantized level — the one the object provably cannot see, B1012)'); frontier/B1015_anchor_declaration/ADDENDUM_2026-08-10.md (both withdrawals; 'epistemic status marked HELD-PENDING-L154'); confirmed current at docs/THE_SM_VERDICT.md line 187 ('No continuous dimensionless input remains anywhere on the list (c is L154's re-posed question)') and docs/CROSSING_REQUIREMENTS.md R11-T2.

claims.statement: No arc later than B1064 (through B1076, dated 2026-08-19, the most recent bank found) advances the identification beyond 'UNDECIDED-narrowed' — the latest campaign-status entries (B1074, B1075, B1076) list L154 only as one of three still-open value-frontier 'doors,' with no new bridge, clash, or narrowing recorded.

claims.statement: Whether a bridge statement identifying the object's own boundary theory with the (E6)_1 current algebra CAN ever be constructed (i.e., whether L154 ultimately resolves SAME) is not resolvable by computation from the currently banked record. It requires either a new construction (a rational/discrete structure on the presently non-compact σ-sector, or a mechanism restoring a quantized sector that survives CS=0 from outside the object's bare action) or a proof of impossibility; neither exists in the bank, and this audit does not supply one.
claims.evidence: Absence confirmed by the corpus searches in claims 6, 7, 10; B1064's own falsifiable-commitment clause names exactly these two reopening conditions and confirms neither is currently banked (frontier/B1064_cusp_torus_repose/FINDINGS.md, 'MB12' section).

d.fail_witnesses: A YES (ONE-OBJECT, closing L154 as SAME/DERIVED) requires exhibiting the still-missing bridge: (a) a banked construction showing the boundary chiral algebra of the object's own AdS3/complex-CS quotient literally CONTAINS the (E6)_1 current algebra, or that its partition function carries the SU(3)_2×(G2)_1 modular fingerprint (6,{16/5,14/5}) exactly — which first requires clearing B1064's Leg-1/Leg-2 obstruction (supplying either a quantized sector that survives CS=0, or a rational/discrete point on the presently non-compact σ-sector) — PLUS (b), if the route runs through the cusp torus, a separate banked "transfer statement" licensing cusp-c ⇔ Brown-Henneaux-c (not assumed by fiat, per the B980 fence). A NO (DIFFERENT, closing L154 negatively) requires exhibiting a CLASH: e.g. a banked fact forcing the boundary theory to be CHIRAL (c_L≠c_R — incompatible with Brown-Henneaux's non-chiral construction and with the object's own amphichirality/CS=0), or a banked independent mechanism that pins ℓ/G (hence σ) to a specific rational ≠1 by a route that does not presuppose the identification, or a proof that no completion of the object's boundary theory (not just its bare classical action) can ever carry a compact/rational current algebra. As of this audit NEITHER a YES-witness nor a NO-witness is banked. B1034's own sealed table (V2×V3 = NO-EXHIBIT×NO-CLASH → UNDECIDED) and B1064's own outcome (O3, NOT-POSABLE on the most direct attempted route, with an explicit two-condition reopening clause) are the record's own statements of exactly this two-sided falsifiability — the cell is genuinely undecided, not merely unattempted.
d.notes:
Method: WORKING_RULES.md was read first as directed. All arithmetic claimed above was independently re-run in-sandbox (sympy, exact rational/symbolic — no floating point was needed anywhere in this derivation chain, which is itself notable) by executing the repo's own scripts verbatim (frontier/B1012_branch_verifications/b1012_verify.py and frontier/B254_uniqueness_chain/uniqueness_chain.py, both read-only, no repo files modified) plus independent from-scratch reproductions in the session scratchpad. House-guard READ-ONLY honored throughout — no writes/edits under the repo root.

Gate 5 check: nothing here is a measured/SM quantity. Every number used is an exact rational determined by Lie-algebra data (dim, dual Coxeter number, level) or by a symbolic gravitational-action identity — schema-only output as instructed, no CLAIMS.md-bound content implied.

Verdict-schema mapping, stated plainly: the task's three offered buckets (ONE-OBJECT / TWO-OBJECTS-EQUAL / NOT-COMPARABLE) do not have an exact banked synonym — the record's own word is UNDECIDED (B1034) / UNDECIDED-narrowed (B1064). Given the task's own gloss on TWO-OBJECTS-EQUAL ("numerically equal, no identification — say what additional fact would identify them"), that is the correct mapping: B1034 confirms NO-EXHIBIT (no identification) and NO-CLASH (nothing forbids the numeric coincidence), and this audit independently confirms the coincidence is real arithmetic (78/13=6=16/5+14/5, and 6σ|σ=1=6) in a matching normalization (no factor between the two c-conventions, ruling out NOT-COMPARABLE on normalization grounds). The one caveat worth flagging explicitly: this is weaker than a textbook "two independently-fixed numbers happened to coincide" — one side (B254's 6) is an unconditional theorem with zero free parameters, while the other side's matching value (σ=1) is not independently fixed by anything banked; it is the value σ would need to take IF the identification held, i.e. it is read off from, not independent of, the hypothesis. σ (equivalently A2=c=6σ) remains a genuine free anchor.

What converts if L154 ever resolves SAME: per CROSSING_REQUIREMENTS R11-T2 / OPEN_LEADS L154 / B1015's addendum, A2 converts from anchor to OUTPUT and the framework's input list shrinks by its only continuous dimensionless member — currently un-triggered.

Four-referent "c" hazard (worth carrying forward): the corpus already tracks that "c" alone is ambiguous in this neighborhood among (i) Sugawara c((E6)_1)=6 [B254], (ii) c_BH=6σ [B1012], (iii) the cusp-torus theory's own (currently undefined) c [B1064], (iv) B559's unrelated c=1 chain — this audit's claims are all typed against (i) and (ii) only.

v.item: THE SIGMA IDENTIFICATION — L154: B1012's gravitational σ vs. B254's (E₆)₁ central charge c=6 (CROSSING_REQUIREMENTS R11-T2)
v.finding:
VERDICT SURVIVES adversarial attack. Independently recomputed from scratch (sympy, exact rationals, no repo code imported for the arithmetic itself, then cross-checked against the well-known E8-lattice sanity anchor c((E8)_1)=248/31=8): c((E6)_1)=78/13=6 exact (13×6=78); c(SU(3)_2)=2·8/5=16/5; c((G2)_1)=1·14/4+1=14/5; sum=16/5+14/5=30/5=6, matching c((E6)_1) exactly; c_BH=3ℓ/(2G) minus 6σ (with σ:=ℓ/4G) simplifies symbolically to 0; solving 6σ=6 gives σ=1 exactly. Both cited scripts were re-run verbatim (frontier/B1012_branch_verifications/b1012_verify.py, frontier/B254_uniqueness_chain/uniqueness_chain.py) and reproduce every printed value claimed. All citations spot-checked against source (B1034 FINDINGS.md, B1064 FINDINGS.md, B1015 ADDENDUM_2026-08-10.md, CROSSING_REQUIREMENTS.md R11 row [verbatim match, filed under the R11 row's "(T2)" sub-item — "R11-T2" is the derivation's own correct shorthand, not a fabricated anchor], B303, B715, B559, CAMPAIGN_STATUS.md, THE_SM_VERDICT.md) confirm exactly as quoted; no arc beyond B1076 (2026-08-19, today's date) exists in frontier/, and B1074/B1075/B1076 each list L154 only as an open "door" — claim 8's currency holds.

WEAKEST CONVERSION STEP, attacked: claim 3 grades "THEOREM-EXACT" the assertion that 6=16/5+14/5 reflects "the known conformal embedding (E6)_1 ⊃ SU(3)_2 × (G2)_1." This overstates what is actually verified. Reading uniqueness_chain.py directly: the only `assert`-checked (tested) decomposition is the THREE-factor (E6)_1 ⊃ SU(3)_2 × SU(2)_3 × U(1) (16/5+9/5+1=6) plus the separate fact (G2)_1 ⊃ SU(2)_3×U(1) (9/5+1=14/5); the two-factor "SU(3)_2 x (G2)_1" line is a PRINT statement, never asserted, and B1034's own FINDINGS.md concedes as much in its own words: "the split's algebras named by their central charges' own arithmetic" — i.e., the labels are reverse-engineered from the numbers, not independently confirmed via a branching-rule/representation check (no analogue of the F4_BRANCH Sage verification done elsewhere in the same file exists for this pair). This is a real grading defect (arithmetic identity: THEOREM-EXACT is fine; "known conformal embedding": not established at that grade here) — but it is NOT load-bearing for the core identification, which needs only the single-algebra, embedding-independent fact c((E6)_1)=78/13=6.

FAIL-WITNESS / MB12 test, run rigorously (not just asserted): swept (simple algebra, level 1-3, rank≤11) for other exact hits at c=6. Found six: (E6)_1, plus (B3)_2 [Spin(7)], (C4)_1 [Sp(8)], (A6)_1 [SU(7), since A_n level 1 gives c=n identically — dim=n(n+2), h∨=n+1], (D6)_1 [SO(12), dim=66, h∨=10, c=66/11=6], (G2)_3. Two of these (SU(7)_1, SO(12)_1) are "boring" single-factor WZW models with zero connection to the figure-eight knot's trace field ℚ(√−3) or 2T (McKay pairs cyclic groups↔A-series, binary dihedral↔D-series, and 2T specifically and uniquely ↔E6 — textbook, not repo-specific). This quantitatively confirms landing on c=6 is cheap (roughly 1-in-a-handful in a small search), so the entire evidential force of "σ=1 is a candidate FORCED value" rests on E6 being independently, externally McKay-forced onto the object BEFORE any σ-comparison (claim 3's own stated reason) — not on 6 being numerically rare. The full argument, applied to my constructed fail-witnesses, correctly does NOT elevate SU(7)_1 or SO(12)_1 to candidate status (neither carries the McKay tie), so the MB12 criterion demonstrably CAN fail and DOES discriminate — it isn't vacuous.

Net: the exact arithmetic is airtight and independently reproduced; the sealed NO-EXHIBIT/NO-CLASH search (B1034) and the O3/NOT-POSABLE direct-construction attempt (B1064) are read directly from source and say what the derivation says; the one genuine defect found (over-graded embedding-existence sub-claim in claim 3) weakens a corroborating detail, not the spine, and if anything reinforces why the record's own verdict stops at UNDECIDED / "candidate value, no identification" rather than anything stronger. The task-schema mapping (TWO-OBJECTS-EQUAL-AT-A-CANDIDATE-VALUE, NO IDENTIFICATION) is an honest rendering of B1034's UNDECIDED and B1064's UNDECIDED-narrowed, not an upgrade.
